title: Joseph B. Noble
vital_facts: Married Adeline Beeman 1837; later practiced plural marriage; thirty-one children
Ordained High Priest and called as Bishop
Trekked west with saints. Arrived Utah 1847
Died 1900 Wardboro, Idaho; Buried Salt Lake City, Utah
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
